paper_thesis_if_survives: Self-evolving skill systems that use package identities as core units of curriculum sampling, retrieval, and credit update are structurally sensitive to semantics-preserving taxonomy transformations (identity duplication, grouping/ungrouping) over a fixed content-addressed primitive basis; this sensitivity persists after standard fixes (text/clone dedup, full-coverage pruning, context-independent global reweighting) when the primitive support hypergraph contains irreducible partial overlap, which occurs in real released systems.
why_current_evidence_is_or_is_not_enough: C1 is supported by first-party control-plane evidence from two released self-evolving skill systems; C2 is confirmed by structural analysis and a tight impossibility theorem verified on the real released Skill-SP support hypergraph. No invalid evidence is used, novelty survives all existing work collisions, and no new dynamic LLM generation is required to establish these narrow bounded claims.
minimum_submission_claims: C1: Real self-evolving skill controllers are representation-sensitive: semantics-preserving identity multiplicity/overlap changes curriculum or fixed-budget retrieval control despite unchanged semantic support, confirmed on two released first-party systems

C2: The representation-sensitivity residual cannot be eliminated by clone/text dedup, exact-coverage whole-package pruning, or arbitrary context-independent global package reweighting when partial overlap is structurally necessary, proven via a tight impossibility theorem on a real released support graph
claims_to_drop: C3: Support-Quotient Control removes taxonomy-representation dependence while preserving all implementation and budget constraints
C4: Representation sensitivity propagates to measurable end-of-evolution state or downstream task performance
strongest_reviewer_objection: The proposed Support-Quotient Control method and the propagation of control-plane sensitivity to end-of-evolution outcomes remain untested on a qualified dynamic substrate, so neither can be claimed as a tested contribution in this narrow submission.
strongest_same_information_reduction: Every pre-context single-package controller (including all neural/bandit adaptive controllers acting before task generation) is analytically reduced to a nonnegative global primitive weight vector at any frozen pre-decision state, so the tight 2x lower bound on exposure inequality applies to the entire class, with no escape via more complex models.
next_zero_gpu_work: Write up the narrow theoretical/diagnostic contribution, formalize the full impossibility and reduction theory, present the existing released control-plane evidence, frame Support-Quotient Control as a testable future hypothesis rather than a tested contribution, and comply strictly with all preregistration constraints.
future_asset_trigger: A preregistered single qualified P0 run on the author's released trained questioner substrate meeting the original >=16 contract-valid generations per source requirement will unlock full evaluation of C3 and C4 for a future full submission.
